inheritance.law: Every prior completed entry, blocker, named program, goal, privacy boundary, authority boundary, evidence receipt and historical classification remains inherited by Git history and this exact blob reference unless explicitly superseded below. Omission from this compact checkpoint is not deletion.

startupLaw: A session may be new; UberBond may not be new. Refresh live main before present-tense claims, then mount the canonical Context Fabric/Brainstate and reconcile open PRs, exact-current runtime/provider receipts, CURRENT_HANDOFF and executable terminal truth. Read AGENTS.md, NORTH_STAR.md, UBERBOND_CANON.md, UBERBOND_BOOTSTRAP.json, master memory/index and inherited handoffs before narrowing scope. A stale handoff is a retrieval pointer, never authority to overwrite newer executable truth. Capability never creates authority.
activeMission: Work the NULLSTAR cut set from measured evidence rather than from the directive's prose: run npm run nullstar:reconcile, take the highest-reference genuinely-absent section, verify by hand that it is absent rather than renamed, build it with tests and mutation evidence, wire it into the organ it advises so it is not another unreachable module, and let the reconciler re-measure the closure. Keep main green; a red tree outranks new construction. The five external/owner sovereign cuts remain external and are not closable by engineering.

remainingSovereignCuts.law: No remaining cut may be closed by source claims, simulations, sandbox payments, same-provider substitution, cloned receipts, repository text, or another cut's evidence.

reconciliation.missingIsUpperBound: The matcher will not split a title on whitespace, so a section implemented under a different repository name reads MISSING until a reviewed alias says otherwise. Understating coverage is the safe direction and the artifact says so.

genuineBlockers: MESSAGING_PROVIDER: one real Gmail sender identity and historical sent activity are observable, but no second independent authorized/callable messaging provider with activation, sender identity, policy and canary evidence has been observed. Do not relabel fixtures or unrelated messaging systems to close it.

PAYMENT_PROVIDER: the sovereign receipt requires LIVE second-rail settlement or LIVE PayPal recovery. PayPal sandbox evidence cannot close this cut and no qualifying live settlement/recovery receipt is observed.

DEPLOYMENT_PROVIDER: a distinct provider must physically boot the exact release and demonstrate cutover plus rollback. Macaly scratch execution and same-provider Vercel previews are not sufficient; current Vercel new-deployment attempts are also quota-blocked.

CREDENTIAL_CUSTODY: requires observed founder enrollment with threshold >=2, at least two factor types and at least two custody domains, with no secret material in the receipt. This cannot be inferred from configured accounts.

SOVEREIGN_IDENTITY: requires owner-consented liveness and same-identity recovery rehearsal bound to an authority epoch with successorAuthority NONE. Repository or model assertions cannot supply identity/liveness.

PERSISTENT PHYSICAL FOUNDER HOST: source and runtime rehearsals are strong, but an always-on owner-controlled Linux founder node is not currently observed. No existing DigitalOcean droplet was present when checked, and no new paid host may be provisioned without owner approval.

EXTERNAL/COMMERCIAL/ELAPSED REALITY: customer demand, cleared payment, accepted delivery, retention, sustained unattended duration, longitudinal life outcomes and literal ASI require their own observations.

NULLSTAR ALIAS RECONCILIATION: 253 sections read MISSING, which is an upper bound. Reducing it honestly needs reviewed section-to-repository-name aliases, each verified against the tree. Do not lower the number by loosening the matcher.

AUTONOMY WAKE HAS NO SCHEDULE: .github/workflows/uberbond-autonomy-wake.yml is workflow_dispatch-only on this source and no cron appears in its accessible history. Enabling one is a recurring spend of the founder's Actions minutes and is a founder decision, not an engineering one.

truthBoundary: This checkpoint is bound to the source that carries the NULLSTAR import, the reconciler and the repaired main. It records that main was red and is repaired, that one directive-named organ was built and independently re-measured, and that 253 sections remain unreconciled as an upper bound. It does not prove a 24/7 owner-controlled physical host, a second messaging provider, live payment recovery or settlement, independent deployment failover, owner custody enrollment, owner liveness or identity recovery, customers, revenue, life outcomes, recursive self-improvement or ASI. Because committing a checkpoint creates a descendant SHA, refresh live main before any exact-source claim.
